parts.label: main
parts.technique: Circular motion (rotating disc, friction providing centripetal force)
parts.reason: This problem requires circular motion concepts (angular speed, centripetal acceleration/force) which are not mentioned in any P or M statement in the 9MA0 specification; only projectiles, SHM-free topics like moments/forces/kinematics in a straight line or plane (constant acceleration/vectors) are covered. Circular motion is absent from the spec statements, so this part is out.

parts.label: a

parts.reason: Requires circular motion (angular speed, centripetal force equations) which no statement in the specification mentions. This is a core M3 topic absent from 9MA0.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Circular motion - condition on normal reaction (R ≥ 0) to find minimum angular speed
parts.reason: Depends on the circular-motion setup and result of part (a); circular motion is not covered by any statement, and this part also relies on the out-of-spec previous part.

parts.label: a

parts.label: b

parts.reason: Depends on the coefficient of friction µ found in part (a) via the out-of-spec energy method, so this part is also out.
